subject: [PATCH 32/60] cgroup/cpuset: keep spread page cache off private nodes

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The original author's root message describes the problem and solution in detail. The code change is relatively straightforward, modifying the cpuset_spread_node function to exclude private nodes from page cache allocation.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to optimize the spread of page cache across nodes in a cgroup/cpuset setup, particularly when memory_spread_page is enabled. The goal is to prevent private nodes from being used for page cache allocation, which can lead to inefficient resource utilization.
